rules.format: Doubles, bring 4 of 4-6, Level 50 auto, IVs fixed 31, 66 Stat Points (max 32 per stat)
rules.teamPreviewShows: species only (moves/items/abilities hidden in online play)

mechanicsNotes: Sleep: 1-2 turns of inaction (2/3 chance of 2)
Freeze: 25% thaw per turn, always thaws by the 3rd turn; Freeze-Dry cannot freeze
Salt Cure: 1/16 per turn (1/8 vs Water/Steel)
Move power/effect changes come from Showdown's Champions data (e.g. Flare Blitz 90, Moonblast 10% SpA drop)

pressure.d: If this Pokemon is the target of a foe's move, that move loses one additional PP.

unburden.d: Speed is doubled on held item loss; boost is lost if it switches, gets new item/Ability.

poisontouch.d: This Pokemon's contact moves have a 30% chance of poisoning.

defiant.d: This Pokemon's Attack is raised by 2 for each of its stats that is lowered by a foe.

supremeoverlord.d: This Pokemon's moves have 10% more power for each fainted ally, up to 5 allies.

swiftswim.d: If Rain Dance is active, this Pokemon's Speed is doubled.

adaptability.d: This Pokemon's same-type attack bonus (STAB) is 2 instead of 1.5.

moldbreaker.d: This Pokemon's moves and their effects ignore the Abilities of other Pokemon.

blaze.d: At 1/3 or less of its max HP, this Pokemon's offensive stat is 1.5x with Fire attacks.

solarpower.d: If Sunny Day is active, this Pokemon's Sp. Atk is 1.5x; loses 1/8 max HP per turn.

overgrow.d: At 1/3 or less of its max HP, this Pokemon's offensive stat is 1.5x with Grass attacks.

grassysurge.d: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Grassy Terrain.

intimidate.d: On switch-in, this Pokemon lowers the Attack of opponents by 1 stage.

sandveil.d: If Sandstorm is active, this Pokemon's evasiveness is 1.25x; immunity to Sandstorm.

roughskin.d: Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon lose 1/8 of their max HP.

cudchew.d: If this Pokemon eats a Berry, it will eat that Berry again at the end of the next turn.

armortail.d: This Pokemon and its allies are protected from opposing priority moves.

sapsipper.d: This Pokemon's Attack is raised 1 stage if hit by a Grass move; Grass immunity.

stamina.d: This Pokemon's Defense is raised by 1 stage after it is damaged by a move.

sturdy.d: If this Pokemon is at full HP, it survives one hit with at least 1 HP. Immune to OHKO.

stalwart.d: This Pokemon's moves cannot be redirected to a different target by any effect.

owntempo.d: This Pokemon cannot be confused. Immune to Intimidate.

synchronize.d: If another Pokemon burns/poisons/paralyzes this Pokemon, it also gets that status.

psychicsurge.d: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Psychic Terrain.

flowerveil.d: This side's Grass types can't have stats lowered or status inflicted by other Pokemon.

symbiosis.d: If an ally uses its item, this Pokemon gives its item to that ally immediately.

innerfocus.d: This Pokemon cannot be made to flinch. Immune to Intimidate.

multiscale.d: If this Pokemon is at full HP, damage taken from attacks is halved.

trace.d: On switch-in, or when it can, this Pokemon copies a random adjacent foe's Ability.

telepathy.d: This Pokemon does not take damage from attacks made by its allies.

keeneye.d: This Pokemon's accuracy can't be lowered by others; ignores their evasiveness stat.

drizzle.d: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Rain Dance.

raindish.d: If Rain Dance is active, this Pokemon heals 1/16 of its max HP each turn.

cutecharm.d: 30% chance of infatuating Pokemon of the opposite gender if they make contact.

pixilate.d: This Pokemon's Normal-type moves become Fairy type and have 1.2x power.

snowcloak.d: If Snow is active, this Pokemon's evasiveness is 1.25x.

cursedbody.d: If this Pokemon is hit by an attack, there is a 30% chance that move gets disabled.

static.d: 30% chance a Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon will be paralyzed.

chlorophyll.d: If Sunny Day is active, this Pokemon's Speed is doubled.

moxie.d: This Pokemon's Attack is raised by 1 stage if it attacks and KOes another Pokemon.

emergencyexit.d: This Pokemon switches out when it reaches 1/2 or less of its maximum HP.

overcoat.d: This Pokemon is immune to powder moves, Sandstorm damage, and Effect Spore.

swarm.d: At 1/3 or less of its max HP, this Pokemon's offensive stat is 1.5x with Bug attacks.

liquidvoice.d: This Pokemon's sound-based moves become Water type.

sandstream.d: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Sandstorm.

unnerve.d: While this Pokemon is active, it prevents opposing Pokemon from using their Berries.

whitesmoke.d: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's stat stages.

drought.d: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Sunny Day.

shellarmor.d: This Pokemon cannot be struck by a critical hit.

sandrush.d: If Sandstorm is active, this Pokemon's Speed is doubled; immunity to Sandstorm.

sandforce.d: This Pokemon's Ground/Rock/Steel attacks do 1.3x in Sandstorm; immunity to it.

magmaarmor.d: This Pokemon cannot be frozen. Gaining this Ability while frozen cures it.

angerpoint.d: If this Pokemon (not its substitute) takes a critical hit, its Attack is raised 12 stages.

immunity.d: This Pokemon cannot be poisoned. Gaining this Ability while poisoned cures it.

opportunist.d: When an opposing Pokemon has a stat stage raised, this Pokemon copies the effect.

justified.d: This Pokemon's Attack is raised by 1 stage after it is damaged by a Dark-type move.

technician.d: This Pokemon's moves of 60 power or less have 1.5x power, including Struggle.

galewings.d: If this Pokemon is at full HP, its Flying-type moves have their priority increased by 1.

merciless.d: This Pokemon's attacks are critical hits if the target is poisoned.

magicbounce.d: This Pokemon blocks certain Status moves and bounces them back to the user.

toughclaws.d: This Pokemon's contact moves have their power multiplied by 1.3.

hypercutter.d: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's Attack stat stage.

sheerforce.d: This Pokemon's attacks with secondary effects have 1.3x power; nullifies the effects.

superluck.d: This Pokemon's critical hit ratio is raised by 1 stage.

voltabsorb.d: This Pokemon heals 1/4 of its max HP when hit by Electric moves; Electric immunity.

ironfist.d: This Pokemon's punch-based attacks have 1.2x power. Sucker Punch is not boosted.

disguise.d: (Mimikyu only) The first hit it takes is blocked, and it takes 1/8 HP damage instead.

stall.d: This Pokemon moves last among Pokemon using the same or greater priority moves.

stancechange.d: If Aegislash, changes Forme to Blade before attacks and Shield before King's Shield.

thermalexchange.d: This Pokemon's Attack is raised by 1 when damaged by Fire moves; can't be burned.

icebody.d: If Snow is active, this Pokemon heals 1/16 of its max HP each turn.

leafguard.d: If Sunny Day is active, this Pokemon cannot be statused and Rest will fail for it.

klutz.d: This Pokemon's held item has no effect, except Macho Brace. Fling cannot be used.

gooey.d: Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon have their Speed lowered by 1 stage.

queenlymajesty.d: This Pokemon and its allies are protected from opposing priority moves.

sweetveil.d: This Pokemon and its allies cannot fall asleep; those already asleep do not wake up.

poisonheal.d: This Pokemon is healed by 1/8 of its max HP each turn when poisoned; no HP loss.

fluffy.d: This Pokemon takes 1/2 damage from contact moves, 2x damage from Fire moves.

poisonpoint.d: 30% chance a Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon will be poisoned.

punkrock.d: This Pokemon receives 1/2 damage from sound moves. Its own have 1.3x power.

hustle.d: This Pokemon's Attack is 1.5x and accuracy of its physical attacks is 0.8x.

libero.d: This Pokemon's type changes to the type of the move it is using. Once per switch-in.

battlearmor.d: This Pokemon cannot be struck by a critical hit.

dryskin.d: This Pokemon is healed 1/4 by Water, 1/8 by Rain; is hurt 1.25x by Fire, 1/8 by Sun.

seedsower.d: When this Pokemon is hit by an attack, the effect of Grassy Terrain begins.

harvest.d: If last item used is a Berry, 50% chance to restore it each end of turn. 100% in Sun.

eartheater.d: This Pokemon heals 1/4 of its max HP when hit by Ground moves; Ground immunity.

rattled.d: Speed is raised 1 stage if hit by a Bug-, Dark-, or Ghost-type attack, or Intimidated.

supersweetsyrup.d: On switch-in, this Pokemon lowers the evasiveness of opponents 1 stage. Once per battle.

stickyhold.d: This Pokemon cannot lose its held item due to another Pokemon's Ability or attack.

tangledfeet.d: This Pokemon's evasiveness is doubled as long as it is confused.

bigpecks.d: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's Defense stat stage.

refrigerate.d: This Pokemon's Normal-type moves become Ice type and have 1.2x power.

mummy.d: Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon have their Ability changed to Mummy.

slushrush.d: If Snow is active, this Pokemon's Speed is doubled.

pickup.d: If this Pokemon has no item, it finds one used by an adjacent Pokemon this turn.

ripen.d: When this Pokemon eats certain Berries, the effects are doubled.

unseenfist.d: This Pokemon's contact moves ignore a target's protection and deal 1/4 the usual damage.
